example_prompt: Point my Cartflox webhooks to https://example.com/webhooks/cartflox and only receive payment.completed, payment.failed and payment.cancelled.

input_schema.description: At least one of `webhookUrl` and `events` is required.

webhookUrl.description: Public `https` URL. An empty string removes the webhook.

mode.description: `test` sets the URL that receives test events. When absent, the address of the key's own mode (a test key sets the test address).

events.description: Events to receive. Omit for all events.

webhookUrl.description: Production webhook URL, `null` when none is set.

testWebhookUrl.description: Test webhook URL, when one was set with `mode: test`.

events.description: Events the workspace receives. Every event when none was selected.

error_schema.description: Error body. `code` is present on transfer endpoints.

gotchas: Pass webhookUrl, events or both (400 when neither). webhookUrl must be a public https address: local addresses, private networks and cloud metadata hosts are refused, and an empty string removes the webhook.

mode says which address is set (live or test); when absent, the key's own mode is used, so a test key sets the test address. Without a test address, the production address receives test events with livemode: false.
events selects the events you receive; the full list, or an empty one, means all of them, future events included. Unknown names get 400 with available_events in the body.

Errors are an HTTP 4xx/5xx status with a JSON body { "error": "<message>" }. Transfer endpoints add a machine-readable code, and so do some other refusals (code test_mode on payment links, rate_limited on webhook resends). A 401 says Missing API key or Invalid API Key.
